{{Short description|FIFA World Cup group}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=December 2025}}
{{Use American English|date=November 2025}}
Group E of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] took place from June 14 to 25, 2026.<ref name="match schedule">{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/1be9ce37eb98fcc5/original/FWC26-Match-Schedule_English.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 26 – Match Schedule |publisher=[[FIFA]] |date=February 4, 2024 |access-date=February 4, 2024}}</ref> The group consisted of [[Germany national football team|Germany]], [[Curaçao national football team|Curaçao]], [[Ivory Coast national football team|Ivory Coast]], and [[Ecuador national football team|Ecuador]].

Four-time world champions Germany finally secured their place in the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]] after failing to progress past the group stage in the last two tournaments, [[2018 FIFA World Cup|2018]] and [[2022 FIFA World Cup|2022]]. Ivory Coast finished as runners-up, progressing to the knockout stage for the first time.

In an upset victory, Ecuador defeated Germany in their last group game, finishing third and advancing as one of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|eight best third-place teams]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 2026 Regulations |publisher=FIFA |date=May 2025 |access-date=June 7, 2025 |archive-date=June 23, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250623212158/https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |url-status=live}}</ref>

However, the three teams performed poorly in the round of 32 and were eliminated from the World Cup. World Cup debutants Curaçao finished last with a single point and were eliminated.

==Standings==
{{2026 FIFA World Cup group tables|Group E}}

In the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]]:<ref name="regulations"/>
* The winner of Group E, [[Germany national football team|Germany]], advanced to play the third-place team of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group D|Group D]], [[Paraguay national football team|Paraguay]].
* The runner-up of Group E, [[Ivory Coast national football team|Ivory Coast]], advanced to play the runner-up of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group I|Group I]], [[Norway national football team|Norway]].
* The third-place team of Group E, [[Ecuador national football team|Ecuador]], advanced to play the winner of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group A|Group A]], [[Mexico national football team|Mexico]], as one of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|eight best third-place teams]] from the group stage.

==Matches==
All times listed are local.<ref name="match schedule"/>

===Germany vs Curaçao===
[[File:Germany vs Curaçao 2026 FIFA World Cup.jpg|thumb|[[NRG Stadium]] in [[Houston]] during a Group E match between Germany and Curaçao]]
The two sides had never met before.

The fixture marked Curaçao's FIFA World Cup debut, making it the smallest country by population ever to qualify for the tournament. Moreover, [[Livano Comenencia]] scored Curaçao's first-ever goal in the tournament.

Germany's seven goals were the most they scored in a World Cup match since 2014, when they also defeated [[Brazil national football team|Brazil]] [[Brazil v Germany (2014 FIFA World Cup)|7–1]] in the semi-final.

===Ivory Coast vs Ecuador===
[[File:Pedro Vite Bazoumana Toure Cote D'Ivoire v Ecuador 14 June 2026-149.jpg|thumb|right|Midway in the match between Ivory Coast and Ecuador]]

The two teams had never met before.

With a goal by [[Amad Diallo]] in the 90th minute, this marked Ivory Coast's first victory against a [[CONMEBOL]] team in the FIFA World Cup since their [[2014 FIFA World Cup Group C#Colombia vs Ivory Coast|2–1 loss]] to [[Colombia national football team|Colombia]] in [[2014 FIFA World Cup|2014]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Amad Diallo scores late winner for Ivory Coast vs. Ecuador |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/soccer/worldcup/2026/06/14/ivory-coast-win-ecuador-amad-diallo-goal/90547104007/ |last=Vertelney |first=Seth |date=2026-06-14 |access-date=2026-06-14 |website=[[USA Today]]}}</ref>

===Germany vs Ivory Coast===
[[File:2026 FIFA World Cup, Germany v Ivory Coast players.jpg|thumb|[[Set piece (football)|Set piece]] between Germany and Ivory Coast]]
The teams have previously faced each other once, in a 2009 friendly match that ended in a 2–2 draw.<ref>{{cite web|title=Germany national football team: record v Ivory Coast|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/germany/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Ivory%20Coast|website=11v11.com|access-date=5 December 2025}}</ref>

===Curaçao vs Ivory Coast===
The two teams had never met before.

With this result, Ivory Coast qualified for the knockout stage of a World Cup for the first time as the Group E runners-up, while Curaçao was ultimately eliminated from the group stage, finishing bottom as a result.

===Ecuador vs Germany===
[[File:Kevin Rodriguez 11, Antonio Rudiger 2 Ecuador v Germany at 2026 Fifa World Cup by YantsImages 03.jpg|thumb|right|During the match between Ecuador and Germany.]]
Germany had won the teams' two previous meetings: a [[2006 FIFA World Cup Group A#Ecuador vs Germany|3–0 group stage victory]] at the [[2006 FIFA World Cup]] (which they hosted) and a 4–2 friendly in 2013.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ecuador national football team: record v Germany|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/ecuador/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Germany|website=11v11.com|access-date=5 December 2025}}</ref>

During the match, total attendance for the tournament reached 3,605,357 spectators. This surpassed the previous record of 3,587,538,<ref name="USATodayRecord2026">{{cite news |last1=D'Andrea |first1=Christian |title=World Cup attendance record shattered before group stage even ends |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/soccer/worldcup/2026/06/25/world-cup-attendance-record-2026-1994-united-states/90701931007/ |work=[[USA Today]] |date=June 25, 2026 |access-date=June 27, 2026}}</ref> which had been held for 32 years by the [[1994 FIFA World Cup]], also hosted in the United States. The record was broken with 44 matches remaining in the tournament.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Florio |first1=Mike |title=With 44 matches to go, the 2026 World Cup has already set an all-time attendance record |url=https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/profootballtalk/rumor-mill/news/with-44-matches-to-go-the-2026-world-cup-as-already-set-an-all-time-attendance-record |work=[[NBC Sports]] |date=June 26, 2026 |access-date=June 27, 2026}}</ref>

Regarded as an upset victory, this was Germany's first group-stage loss since their [[2022 FIFA World Cup Group E#Germany vs Japan|2–1 defeat]] to [[Japan national football team|Japan]] in [[2022 FIFA World Cup|2022]].

==Discipline==
The team conduct ("fair play") score would have been used as a tiebreaker if the head-to-head and overall records of teams were tied. It would also be used as a tiebreaker for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|third-place ranking]] between groups if the overall records of teams were tied. The score was calculated based on yellow and red cards received by players and team officials in all group matches as follows:<ref name="regulations"/>
*yellow card: −1 point;
*indirect red card (second yellow card): −3 points;
*direct red card: −4 points;
*yellow card and direct red card: −5 points;

Only one of the above deductions could be applied to a player or team official in a single match.
